summary: Sprint 3 (checkout invoice + Google reviews + admin pin + About-us back + AI finder text + softer overlay) E2E PASSED. Backend pytest 59/59 (51 regression + 8 new). Frontend verified end-to-end: Add to Cart -> Cart -> Secure Checkout (single soft overlay, no 'void') -> Place Order -> Order Confirmation invoice screen rendered with order-id-badge 'Order #61DCE322', itemized bill (₹999/₹50/₹180/₹1229), Home Delivery + address, 36 reward points, and the 3 buttons Print Invoice / Share on WhatsApp / Continue Shopping all wired.
